findings.message: scrim run falls back to the home mirror: darwin has no user or mount namespaces; tools that bypass HOME still read the real credential files
findings.fix: allow unprivileged user namespaces (on Ubuntu: sysctl kernel.apparmor_restrict_unprivileged_userns=0, or an AppArmor profile for scrim that allows userns), or accept the gaps listed in `scrim status`
